# Exende

> Public hiring data, observed over time, with focused infrastructure APIs for autonomous software.

## Jobs & Hiring Data

- [Product](https://exende.dev/products/jobs)
- [Public overview documentation](https://exende.dev/docs/jobs)
- Public endpoint: `GET https://dataapi-api-production.daniel-zaharia-dev.workers.dev/v1/public/overview`
- Authentication: none
- Payload boundary: aggregate catalogue counts and data freshness only
- Customer job search, company data, accounts, subscriptions, and scoped API keys: coming soon

The public overview contains `active_jobs`, `active_companies`, `active_sources`, and nullable `last_updated_at`. It does not expose listings, company profiles, source health, raw payloads, protected history, customer records, or operator tooling.

- [Documentation index](https://exende.dev/docs)

- [Production API surface](https://exende.dev/api)

## Machine-readable contracts

- [Callback OpenAPI 3.1](https://exende.dev/openapi/callback.json)
- [Retry OpenAPI 3.1](https://exende.dev/openapi/retry.json)
- [Resolve OpenAPI 3.1](https://exende.dev/openapi/resolve.json)
- [API catalog](https://exende.dev/api/catalog.json)
- [Extended agent context](https://exende.dev/llms-full.txt)

Callback costs $0.01 USDC, Retry costs $0.02 USDC, and Resolve costs $0.03 USDC on their x402-paid paths. They use x402 v2 exact settlement on Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`). Use each current PAYMENT-REQUIRED response for authoritative settlement requirements and never hardcode the recipient address.
